class ProjectPaths:
    """Centralized path resolution for the basicmodel project.

    Class-level constants for the project root and standard
    subdirectories (data, output). Helper classmethods resolve
    relative paths and ensure output dirs exist before write.
    """
    BASE_DIR    = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    PROJECT_DIR = os.path.dirname(BASE_DIR)  # basicmodel/ root
    DATA_DIR    = os.path.join(PROJECT_DIR, "data")
    OUTPUT_DIR  = os.path.join(PROJECT_DIR, "output")

    @classmethod
    def ensure_output_dir(cls):
        """Create ``OUTPUT_DIR`` if missing; return the absolute path."""
        os.makedirs(cls.OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        return cls.OUTPUT_DIR

    @classmethod
    def output_path(cls, filename):
        """Absolute path to ``OUTPUT_DIR/<filename>`` (creates the dir)."""
        return os.path.join(cls.ensure_output_dir(), filename)

    @classmethod
    def output_stem(cls, stem):
        """Absolute path to ``OUTPUT_DIR/<stem>`` (no extension joined)."""
        return os.path.join(cls.ensure_output_dir(), stem)

    @classmethod
    def resolve_xml(cls, path):
        """Resolve an XML path relative to PROJECT_DIR if not absolute.

        Lets call sites accept either short ``data/foo.xml`` or full
        absolute paths without branching at every entry point.
        """
        if not os.path.isabs(path):
            return os.path.join(cls.PROJECT_DIR, path)
        return path


def atomic_torch_save(obj, path):
    """torch.save to ``{path}.tmp`` then atomically rename onto ``path``.

    Leaves the original ``path`` untouched if the save fails. Any stale
    ``{path}.tmp`` orphan at the target (from a prior crashed save) is
    removed first, and a partial tmp from this save is cleaned up on
    failure so orphans cannot accumulate.
    """
    tmp_path = f"{path}.tmp"
    if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
        os.remove(tmp_path)
    try:
        torch.save(obj, tmp_path)
    except BaseException:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            try:
                os.remove(tmp_path)
            except OSError:
                pass
        raise
    os.replace(tmp_path, path)


_VALID_USE_GRAMMAR = ("all", "thoughtFree", "none")


def parse_use_grammar(value) -> str:
    """Normalize useGrammar config into the tri-state {"all", "thoughtFree", "none"}.

    Raises ``ValueError`` for any non-string or unknown value so XML
    typos surface at config-load time rather than silently disabling
    grammar dispatch downstream.
    """
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(
            f"useGrammar must be a string, got {type(value).__name__}"
        )
    if value not in _VALID_USE_GRAMMAR:
        raise ValueError(
            f"useGrammar must be one of {_VALID_USE_GRAMMAR}, got {value!r}"
        )
    return value

      <!-- Quaternary-corner balance knobs (tetralemma / catuskoti): select
           which corners of {T, F, N, B} are permitted during training. See
           basicmodel/doc/Philosophy.md for the 4-valued (quaternary)
           truth semantics.
             allowExcludedMiddle:  1  = permit NEITHER (default)
                                  -1  = forbid NEITHER (classical LEM)
             allowContradiction:   0  = forbid BOTH (default, non-contradiction)
                                   1  = permit BOTH (paraconsistent / LP)
       -->
      <xs:element name="allowExcludedMiddle" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="allowContradiction" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Shared tetralemma policy block for ConceptualSpace /
           WholeSpace; per-space override via that section's
           ``<tetralemmaOverride enabled="true">`` plus its own nested
           <TetralemmaPolicy>. -->
      <xs:element name="TetralemmaPolicy" type="tetralemmaPolicyType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="l1Lambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="discontinuityLambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="useSubspaceActivation" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="certainty" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="amp" type="ampModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Runtime device default (cpu | gpu | cuda | mps). Env override:
           BASICMODEL_DEVICE. Gate fixtures pin cpu: MPS kernels are
           nondeterministic, so a seeded gate only reproduces on CPU. -->
      <xs:element name="device" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- L1 penalty on lift / lower gates. 0 disables. -->
      <xs:element name="gateL1Lambda" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Sparse-MoE load-balance loss weight. Currently inert: the
           load-balance bookkeeping retired with the chart and this knob
           has no consumer yet; it stands by for future signal-router
           rule load-balancing. -->
      <xs:element name="loadBalanceWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maxActivePerLayer" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Single continuous truth bar in [0, 1] (read onto ConceptualSpace
           AND WholeSpace; overridable per-space). 0 = record/accept all
           truths, 1 = none. Governs BOTH content-aware learned-relation
           codebook insertion and WholeSpace truth recording (gold +
           training). Replaces the retired binary accumulateTruth /
           truthMinMagnitude switches. -->
      <!-- Model-level trust in incoming assertions/testimony. Effective
           signed DoT = this multiplier * incoming trust. For persisted STM
           descriptions, absolute rows store this event trust and relative rows
           apply it to the relation's collapsed scalar trust. -->
      <xs:element name="trust" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookRetire" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="symbolLearning" type="symbolLearningType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Per-stage chart re-parse retired 2026-05-12 alongside chart-
           at-stem.  The chart now fires uniformly at C-tier inside
           every body stage; the legacy reparse knob is no longer read. -->
      <!-- Retired compatibility knob. MereologicalTree has been removed;
           values are accepted but ignored. -->
      <xs:element name="mereologicalTreeSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Optional: dump POS-labelled syntax tree at end of every
           MentalModel.forward(); see doc/Language.md "POS side-channel". -->
      <xs:element name="writeSyntax" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="syntaxOutPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <!-- Per-space symbolic-RETRIEVAL mode (doc/plans/2026-06-06-symbolic-
       heat-retrieval.md, Handoff addendum). This is NOT transformer/QKV
       self-attention: the attention element selects how the reverse path
       biases codebook-row retrieval (content proximity + taxonomy heat).
         off          : no heat-biased retrieval; current reverse behavior
                        (DEFAULT; configs with no attention resolve here).
         primer       : row heat only (Taxonomy._priming / priming_mask).
         second-order : dense feature-space carrier C = A_S^T diag(r_S) A_S.
         low-rank     : active factors U = diag(sqrt(r_S)) A_S; Cq = U^T(Uq)
                        without materializing C.
       The legacy boolean hasAttention (which formerly requested a QKV
       AttentionLayer in PartSpace/ConceptualSpace) is DEPRECATED and
       inert; it is kept only as a backward-compat alias (data/model.xml still
       sets it). New configs should use the attention element instead. The
       mode is stored on the owning space and consumed by the reverse-
       retrieval path (later tasks); off preserves current behavior. -->
  <xs:simpleType name="attentionModeEnum">
    <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
      <xs:enumeration value="off"/>
      <xs:enumeration value="primer"/>
      <xs:enumeration value="second-order"/>
      <xs:enumeration value="low-rank"/>

  </xs:simpleType>

      <xs:element name="mathTestDepths" type="xs:string"/>
      <xs:element name="mathDistractors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger"/>
      <xs:element name="mathStage" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger"/>

           addition is iterated succession). -->
      <xs:element name="mathOperators" type="xs:string"/>
      <xs:element name="mathSeed" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger"/>
      <xs:element name="mathProblems" type="xs:positiveInteger"/>
      <xs:element name="input">

          <xs:simpleContent>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       Training section
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <xs:complexType name="trainingType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="numTrials" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="numEpochs" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- RNG seed for the whole run (torch/python/numpy). Pins
           construction-time init and data order so single CLI runs are
           reproducible; the XOR_exact gates rely on this. Env override:
           BASIC_SEED. -->
      <xs:element name="seed" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="batchSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Pack consecutive complete sentences independently within each
           contiguous batch row up to serialWordCapacity. The compiled brick
           owns row-local soft sentence boundaries; no sentence is clipped. -->
      <xs:element name="packSentences" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- DataLoader prefetch workers. 0 means synchronous in-process
           batch assembly. -->
      <xs:element name="numWorkers" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="learningRate" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- reconstructionScale: blend weight between OutputSpace
           prediction loss and reconstruction loss. Higher value =
           more reconstruction. 0 = output-only training.
           Legacy name reverseScale still parsed (with deprecation
           warning) by util.TheXMLConfig. -->
      <xs:element name="reconstructionScale" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Every N batches, log weighted reconstruction/output/expectation
           norms and cosine per shared operator/codebook. Read-only; 0 disables. -->
      <xs:element name="branchDiagnosticsEvery" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Centralize complete-present-input reconstruction, clean targets,
           objective corpus addresses, and loss reporting in Teacher. The
           objective address is separate supervision/conditioning metadata;
           Teacher never overwrites subjective .where/.when. -->
      <xs:element name="teacherReconstruction" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- When true, serial reconstruction trains an idea-only reverse
           construction student from stopgrad(S), with ReconstructionStack's
           rule/arity/leaves as detached targets. This removes the long
           reverse-through-forward recurrent gradient. -->
      <xs:element name="detachedReverse" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="reconstructInLoop" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="reconstructionPlacement" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="graph"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="compiled"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="eager"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <!-- Bound candidates per side of a lossy reconstruction search.
           Independent of word and STM capacity; pair work is at most K*K. -->
      <xs:element name="reconstructionBasisLimit" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="outputInLoop" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of sampled output-action credit from supplied supervised
           answer error. Input compose choices are not answer supervision;
           unavailable targets and zero weight give no policy update. -->
      <xs:element name="outputPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="grammarLessonWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Deprecated legacy alias for reconstructionScale; util.TheXMLConfig
           remaps it (with a deprecation warning). Accepted here so
           unmigrated configs still validate. -->
      <xs:element name="reverseScale" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="whatScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="whereScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="whenScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="negSamples" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="TruthLoss" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Retired separate soft bridge policy. Zero remains loadable for
           old configurations; nonzero values are rejected by model setup. -->
      <xs:element name="answerLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Retired separate next-idea blend. Zero remains loadable for old
           configurations; nonzero values are rejected by model setup. -->
      <xs:element name="predictNextLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Migration alias: max(thinkingLossWeight, whatThinkingPolicyWeight,
           selectedThoughtPolicyWeight) enables the one normal policy once. -->
      <xs:element name="thinkingLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Migration alias for selectedThoughtPolicyWeight; no parity head. -->
      <xs:element name="whatThinkingPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of the one normal controller's REINFORCE objective:
           per-row supplied-answer error plus actual shared work cost. 0 keeps its deterministic query-then-finish
           baseline and contributes no policy term. -->
      <xs:element name="selectedThoughtPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Method-1 -> Method-2 leaf distillation weight (doc/plans/
           2026-07-14-signed-space-snap-design.md, step 3): trains the
           LeafDecoderHead to regenerate the EXACT per-word leaves (the
           Method-1 teacher slab) from the collapsed sentence root, so the
           root stays SEPARABLE per sentence (the measured attractor
           collapse). 0.0 = off (byte-identical; the head is not built). -->
      <xs:element name="leafDistillWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maskRate" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="trainEmbedding" type="trainEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="embeddingScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of the conceptual-similarity SBOW loss (the rotation SBOW that
           situates ConceptualSpace.similarity_codebook, which is always built).
           Default 0.0 = the SBOW does not fire and the forward is byte-identical;
           > 0 trains the codebook in the parallel (symbolicOrder=0) forward. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualSimilarityScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Context-owned update law for the aligned serial concept dictionary.
           Positive values convert its construction Parameter into a persistent
           non-grad buffer, remove it from all optimizer/RowLocalAdam groups,
           and rotate the initially unit-norm atoms once per completed
           sentence. Mutually exclusive with conceptualSimilarityScale. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextLearningRate" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Number of deterministic detached negative prototype rows used by
           the contextual rotation reducer. Default 4 when omitted. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextNegatives" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextSituationWeight" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextSituationAnchors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextExpectationWeight" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- <definitionSparsityScale> (snap contract sec 5, 2026-07-06): lambda
           for the rank-ordered soft-L0 that keeps concept definitions compact
           (shrinks the surplus concept->symbol in-edges past definitionFreeSize).
           Default 0.0 = no penalty, byte-identical. -->
      <xs:element name="definitionSparsityScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="autoload" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="autosave" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="checkpointEveryBatches" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="profile" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="certainty" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Automatic sentence expectation; ARMA remains separately weighted.
           sentenceExpectation replaces the retired sentencePrediction name. -->
      <xs:element name="sentenceExpectation" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="sentenceExpectationScope" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="structured"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="root"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <xs:element name="armaScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationGain" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationQueryBudget" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- In-STM autoregressive prediction (IntraSentenceLayer). Loss
           weight on the per-word L_intra = MSE(predicted idea, observed
           idea), added to the IR-loss path. The PI-then-Sigma predictor
           is owned by ConceptualSpace. -->
      <xs:element name="intraLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Inter-sentence end-state prediction. Structured scope scores
           distinct occupied NP1/VP/NP2 vectors plus presence logits;
           root scope retains the historical single-vector MSE baseline.
           This scales the mean over eligible observed sentences. -->
      <xs:element name="interLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- InfoNCE next-idea contrastive term: weight + softmax temperature.
           Reuses the InterSentenceLayer end-state chain (positive next root
           ranked above the chain's past roots). 0.0 weight -> MSE-only
           (byte-identical). -->
      <xs:element name="interContrastiveWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="interContrastiveTemp" type="positiveFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       Server section
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <xs:complexType name="serverType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="host" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>

            <xs:enumeration value="mphf"/>

      <xs:element name="wordStore" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>

       lives here, not in the within-sentence body — the body is now

      <xs:element name="downwardGeneration" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="language" type="languageType" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="embeddingsType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="numShards" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maxDocs" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="vectorSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="trainingEpochs" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="minCount" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="artifactPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>

       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <!-- ``start`` may repeat: multiple ``<start>`` tags define accepted

      <xs:element name="grammar" type="grammarType" minOccurs="0"/>

  <xs:complexType name="grammarSectionType">

           false preserves the ordinary cached-derivation reverse path. -->
      <xs:element name="reconstructFromIdea" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Shared normal-controller work allowance for reason_about and
           answer_query: choices, reads, traversal and all children. Default 1;
           zero disables these explicit APIs. Natural text must first own a
           selected completed meaning. -->
      <xs:element name="reasoningIterations" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Shared work allowance for think_about on the same controller.
           Absent or zero disables this API. No second kernel result exists. -->
      <xs:element name="thinkingBudget" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- DEPRECATED alias for reasoningIterations (the prior boolean gate).
           When true it enables reasoning at the shared work allowance (10); prefer
           <reasoningIterations>. Default false. -->
      <xs:element name="queryReasoning" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Serial word-at-a-time object/meta (doc/specs/mereological-order-
           raising.md "Serial-mode word-at-a-time loop"). When true (serial
           traversal only), InputSpace owns a fixed-width word loop and hands
           each complete word's local percept ids/mask/locations to PartSpace.
           PS performs the M-to-1 synthesis inside that iteration, then one
           aligned word concept commits to STM. Whole-sentence context re-enters
           via the §6c prelude's gist/intent. Independent of <mereologyRaise>.
           Default false keeps the legacy per-slot path. -->
      <xs:element name="serialObjectMeta" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Maximum number of surface words traversed by the OUTER serial
           sentence loop. Independent of PartSpace/WholeSpace field width and
           ConceptualSpace STM capacity: grammar reductions keep the bounded
           STM live while this loop may traverse a much longer sentence. -->
      <xs:element name="serialWordCapacity" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Fixed raw radix-residual extent P presented to the compiled word
           loop. It is an input layout, not PartSpace's live field width. -->
      <xs:element name="serialResidualPartCapacity"
                  type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Comma-separated staging capacities for serial traversal. The eager
           InputSpace stem selects the smallest width that contains the
           longest sentence in the batch; serialWordCapacity remains the hard
           maximum. A tensor while-loop configuration may provide only that
           maximum (for example "256"): runtime execution then stops at the
           final live column without compiling smaller shapes. -->
      <xs:element name="serialWordBuckets" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Truth / Ideas routing is structural, not flag-gated: accepted
           relative relations reduce to WS META when both entity operands snap
           to existing WS codebook rows; otherwise the composed-idea relation is
           stored explicitly with scalar trust. The <trust> multiplier below
           applies to incoming assertions/testimony before they enter the
           TruthSet, LTM, or learned-relation stores. -->
      <!-- LTM consolidation (doc/specs/mereological-order-raising.md "Truth /
           Ideas processing", "Two consolidation questions"; Alec 2026-06-18).
           When true, the discourse LTM (InterSentenceLayer end-state chain) and
           the RelativeTruthStore are COMBINED into ONE unified TernaryTruthStore
           tensor (Layers.TernaryTruthStore): rows (NP1, VP, NP2) of FULL idea
           vectors + a per-row timestamp + a scalar trust, stored UNSCALED. The
           store is constructed on SymbolicSubSpace (ltm_store), written at the
           observe site (every end-state appends a row), retired RelativeTruthStore
           (relative_store is built ONLY when this gate is OFF), persists via
           submodule registration (rides the state_dict) and survives Reset
           (it is an attribute, not in self.layers). reason/verify_relation read
           it on the content-width slice. Augmentable from an XML <truthSet> at
           load (provision_ltm). Off by default -> the legacy two-store path
           (byte-identical). This gate governs the storage home; the
           reduce-or-describe routing itself is structural. -->
      <xs:element name="ltmConsolidation" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- LTM provisioning (doc/specs/mereological-order-raising.md "Augment the
           LTM by parsing a TruthSet from XML config"; Alec 2026-06-18). A set of
           trusted truths appended to the consolidated LTM at model load
           (provision_ltm), earliest timestamps. Each <truth> carries the text
           (the 'text' attribute or element content) and a 'trust' value in
           [-1, 1]. Grammar determines the field's structure; provenance
           supplies no declared kind. Trust is multiplied by architecture.<trust>. Read only
           when <ltmConsolidation> is on and an ltm_store exists; otherwise
           ignored. See <trust> for the runtime (JSON)
           truth-ingest path; this is the static, config-time provisioning path. -->
      <xs:element name="truthSet" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:complexType>
          <xs:sequence>
            <xs:element name="truth" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded">
              <xs:complexType>
                <xs:simpleContent>
                  <xs:extension base="xs:string">
                    <xs:attribute name="text" type="xs:string"/>
                    <xs:attribute name="trust" type="xs:decimal"/>
                  </xs:extension>
                </xs:simpleContent>
              </xs:complexType>
            </xs:element>
          </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
      </xs:element>
      <!-- Stateless server (mirrors the WikiOracle server.stateless flag;
           the shipped deployment runs in stateless mode). When true
           (DEFAULT), each request is self-contained: the runtime request-body
           TruthSet (store_truths, ORIGIN_USER rows in the consolidated LTM) is
           NOT durable, so on every state_dict load the LTM is revived WITHOUT
           the user rows (only the config-provisioned and conversation rows
           persist) and the TruthLayer view is rematerialized. Set false for a
           stateful deployment where a saved checkpoint's user rows are the
           durable state and must survive reload. Read only when
           <ltmConsolidation> is on. -->
      <xs:element name="stateless" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- GrammarOpsPass §6c (author sign-off 2026-06-11): the sentence
           protocol. In serial mode every sentence opens with an
           independent PARALLEL prelude of <subsymbolicOrder> pumps
           (pump zero: EMA on, intent-only commit — the gist primes
           both towers via §5 set_intent; nothing enters the
           workspace), then the per-word serial task runs under the
           §6d serial partition; the gist re-pumps on preemption only.
           Default false until the author's cutover. -->
      <xs:element name="sentenceProtocol" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Task 4 (doc/plans/2026-05-29-stm-serial-parallel-modes.md §4):
           per-word router-fire gating for serial mode.
             per-word  = fire symbolSpace.compose once per word in the
                         serial per-word loop (intra-predictor routing
                         context); boundary fire OFF.
             boundary  = fire only at the sentence boundary
                         (_chart_compose_at_C / _chart_generate_from_stm);
                         the inter-sentence predictor's routing snapshot.
             both      = (DEFAULT) per-word AND boundary both fire.
             off       = neither fires. -->
      <xs:element name="routerWireSerial" type="routerWireSerialEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="processSymbols" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Meronomy mode (MeronomySpec; MeronomyPlan Stage 9 cutover,
           2026-06-11): "on" binds the meronymic slots (PS.sigma /
           WS.pi) directly to the membership kernels via the
           membership-native adapter and
           enables the interface factoring, the pole-quotient
           reference-half lookup, and the word/object binding table.
           Text on|off (default off in code; the cutover sets "on" in
           model.xml). dMaxStable bounds the complete learned fold's
           inverse gain (default 4.0). -->
      <xs:element name="meronomy" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:complexType>
          <xs:simpleContent>
            <xs:extension base="xs:string">
              <xs:attribute name="dMaxStable" type="nonNegativeFloat"/>
            </xs:extension>
          </xs:simpleContent>
        </xs:complexType>
      </xs:element>
      <xs:element name="ergodic" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="naive" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Master switch for symbolic-priming heat (forward working memory);
           default false = off, zero training-path cost. Plan
           2026-06-06-symbolic-heat-retrieval. -->
      <xs:element name="symbolicPriming" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Retrieval scalar knobs for heat-biased candidate scoring
           (plan §Configuration, doc/plans/2026-06-06-symbolic-heat-retrieval.md).
           All optional; defaults preserved in code (off by default when
           attention=off).  retrievalTopKContent / retrievalTopKHeat: candidate
           union sizes.  retrievalOuterTopK: active rows for outer-heat builders.
           retrievalAlpha / retrievalBeta: content-sim / heat-log weights.
           retrievalGamma / retrievalDelta: first- / second-order carrier weights
           (zero = off = byte-identical to primer mode).
           retrievalUseOuterProduct: reserved for future dense-C gating. -->
      <xs:element name="retrievalTopKContent" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalTopKHeat" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalOuterTopK" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalAlpha" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalBeta" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalGamma" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalDelta" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="retrievalUseOuterProduct" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="sigmaPi" type="sigmaPiEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Trial-split: fraction of training batches run as pure next-idea
           prediction trials (reconstruction terms zeroed). 0.0 -> off ->
           byte-identical. -->
      <xs:element name="predictionTrialRatio" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maxResponseLength" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="data" type="dataType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="training" type="trainingType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Architecture-level embedding-training override. Models.py reads
           ``trainEmbeddings`` (and singular ``trainEmbedding``) from the
           architecture block ahead of ``<training><trainEmbedding>``; the
           boolean plural form maps true -> BOTH, false -> NONE. -->
      <xs:element name="trainEmbeddings" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="trainEmbedding" type="trainEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="server" type="serverType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhere" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhen" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="embeddingPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="weightsPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="monotonic" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="truthBiasScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="LuminosityWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="UniversalityWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Quaternary-corner balance knobs (tetralemma / catuskoti): select
           which corners of {T, F, N, B} are permitted during training. See
           basicmodel/doc/Philosophy.md for the 4-valued (quaternary)
           truth semantics.
             allowExcludedMiddle:  1  = permit NEITHER (default)
                                  -1  = forbid NEITHER (classical LEM)
             allowContradiction:   0  = forbid BOTH (default, non-contradiction)
                                   1  = permit BOTH (paraconsistent / LP)
       -->
      <xs:element name="allowExcludedMiddle" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="allowContradiction" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Shared tetralemma policy block for ConceptualSpace /
           WholeSpace; per-space override via that section's
           ``<tetralemmaOverride enabled="true">`` plus its own nested
           <TetralemmaPolicy>. -->
      <xs:element name="TetralemmaPolicy" type="tetralemmaPolicyType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="l1Lambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="discontinuityLambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="useSubspaceActivation" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="certainty" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="amp" type="ampModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Runtime device default (cpu | gpu | cuda | mps). Env override:
           BASICMODEL_DEVICE. Gate fixtures pin cpu: MPS kernels are
           nondeterministic, so a seeded gate only reproduces on CPU. -->
      <xs:element name="device" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- L1 penalty on lift / lower gates. 0 disables. -->
      <xs:element name="gateL1Lambda" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Sparse-MoE load-balance loss weight. Currently inert: the
           load-balance bookkeeping retired with the chart and this knob
           has no consumer yet; it stands by for future signal-router
           rule load-balancing. -->
      <xs:element name="loadBalanceWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maxActivePerLayer" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Single continuous truth bar in [0, 1] (read onto ConceptualSpace
           AND WholeSpace; overridable per-space). 0 = record/accept all
           truths, 1 = none. Governs BOTH content-aware learned-relation
           codebook insertion and WholeSpace truth recording (gold +
           training). Replaces the retired binary accumulateTruth /
           truthMinMagnitude switches. -->
      <!-- Model-level trust in incoming assertions/testimony. Effective
           signed DoT = this multiplier * incoming trust. For persisted STM
           descriptions, absolute rows store this event trust and relative rows
           apply it to the relation's collapsed scalar trust. -->
      <xs:element name="trust" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookRetire" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="symbolLearning" type="symbolLearningType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Per-stage chart re-parse retired 2026-05-12 alongside chart-
           at-stem.  The chart now fires uniformly at C-tier inside
           every body stage; the legacy reparse knob is no longer read. -->
      <!-- Retired compatibility knob. MereologicalTree has been removed;
           values are accepted but ignored. -->
      <xs:element name="mereologicalTreeSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Optional: dump POS-labelled syntax tree at end of every
           MentalModel.forward(); see doc/Language.md "POS side-channel". -->
      <xs:element name="writeSyntax" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="syntaxOutPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <!-- Per-space symbolic-RETRIEVAL mode (doc/plans/2026-06-06-symbolic-
       heat-retrieval.md, Handoff addendum). This is NOT transformer/QKV
       self-attention: the attention element selects how the reverse path
       biases codebook-row retrieval (content proximity + taxonomy heat).
         off          : no heat-biased retrieval; current reverse behavior
                        (DEFAULT; configs with no attention resolve here).
         primer       : row heat only (Taxonomy._priming / priming_mask).
         second-order : dense feature-space carrier C = A_S^T diag(r_S) A_S.
         low-rank     : active factors U = diag(sqrt(r_S)) A_S; Cq = U^T(Uq)
                        without materializing C.
       The legacy boolean hasAttention (which formerly requested a QKV
       AttentionLayer in PartSpace/ConceptualSpace) is DEPRECATED and
       inert; it is kept only as a backward-compat alias (data/model.xml still
       sets it). New configs should use the attention element instead. The
       mode is stored on the owning space and consumed by the reverse-
       retrieval path (later tasks); off preserves current behavior. -->
  <xs:simpleType name="attentionModeEnum">

      <xs:enumeration value="primer"/>
      <xs:enumeration value="second-order"/>

  </xs:simpleType>

      <xs:element name="input">

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       Training section
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <xs:complexType name="trainingType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="numTrials" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="numEpochs" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- RNG seed for the whole run (torch/python/numpy). Pins
           construction-time init and data order so single CLI runs are
           reproducible; the XOR_exact gates rely on this. Env override:
           BASIC_SEED. -->
      <xs:element name="seed" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="batchSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Pack consecutive complete sentences independently within each
           contiguous batch row up to serialWordCapacity. The compiled brick
           owns row-local soft sentence boundaries; no sentence is clipped. -->
      <xs:element name="packSentences" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- DataLoader prefetch workers. 0 means synchronous in-process
           batch assembly. -->
      <xs:element name="numWorkers" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="learningRate" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- reconstructionScale: blend weight between OutputSpace
           prediction loss and reconstruction loss. Higher value =
           more reconstruction. 0 = output-only training.
           warning) by util.TheXMLConfig. -->
      <xs:element name="reconstructionScale" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Every N batches, log weighted reconstruction/output/expectation
           norms and cosine per shared operator/codebook. Read-only; 0 disables. -->
      <xs:element name="branchDiagnosticsEvery" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Centralize complete-present-input reconstruction, clean targets,
           objective corpus addresses, and loss reporting in Teacher. The
           objective address is separate supervision/conditioning metadata;
           Teacher never overwrites subjective .where/.when. -->
      <xs:element name="teacherReconstruction" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- When true, serial reconstruction trains an idea-only reverse
           construction student from stopgrad(S), with ReconstructionStack's
           rule/arity/leaves as detached targets. This removes the long
           reverse-through-forward recurrent gradient. -->
      <xs:element name="detachedReverse" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="reconstructInLoop" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="reconstructionPlacement" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="graph"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="compiled"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="eager"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <!-- Bound candidates per side of a lossy reconstruction search.
           Independent of word and STM capacity; pair work is at most K*K. -->
      <xs:element name="reconstructionBasisLimit" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="outputInLoop" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of sampled output-action credit from supplied supervised
           answer error. Input compose choices are not answer supervision;
           unavailable targets and zero weight give no policy update. -->
      <xs:element name="outputPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="grammarLessonWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Deprecated legacy alias for reconstructionScale; util.TheXMLConfig
           remaps it (with a deprecation warning). Accepted here so
           unmigrated configs still validate. -->
      <xs:element name="whatScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="whereScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="whenScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="negSamples" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="TruthLoss" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Retired separate soft bridge policy. Zero remains loadable for
           old configurations; nonzero values are rejected by model setup. -->
      <xs:element name="answerLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Retired separate next-idea blend. Zero remains loadable for old
           configurations; nonzero values are rejected by model setup. -->
      <xs:element name="predictNextLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Migration alias: max(thinkingLossWeight, whatThinkingPolicyWeight,
           selectedThoughtPolicyWeight) enables the one normal policy once. -->
      <xs:element name="thinkingLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Migration alias for selectedThoughtPolicyWeight; no parity head. -->
      <xs:element name="whatThinkingPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of the one normal controller's REINFORCE objective:
           per-row supplied-answer error plus actual shared work cost. 0 keeps its deterministic query-then-finish
           baseline and contributes no policy term. -->
      <xs:element name="selectedThoughtPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Method-1 -> Method-2 leaf distillation weight (doc/plans/
           2026-07-14-signed-space-snap-design.md, step 3): trains the
           LeafDecoderHead to regenerate the EXACT per-word leaves (the
           Method-1 teacher slab) from the collapsed sentence root, so the
           root stays SEPARABLE per sentence (the measured attractor
           collapse). 0.0 = off (byte-identical; the head is not built). -->
      <xs:element name="leafDistillWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maskRate" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="trainEmbedding" type="trainEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="embeddingScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Weight of the conceptual-similarity SBOW loss (the rotation SBOW that
           situates ConceptualSpace.similarity_codebook, which is always built).
           Default 0.0 = the SBOW does not fire and the forward is byte-identical;
           > 0 trains the codebook in the parallel (symbolicOrder=0) forward. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualSimilarityScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Context-owned update law for the aligned serial concept dictionary.
           Positive values convert its construction Parameter into a persistent
           non-grad buffer, remove it from all optimizer/RowLocalAdam groups,
           and rotate the initially unit-norm atoms once per completed
           sentence. Mutually exclusive with conceptualSimilarityScale. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextLearningRate" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Number of deterministic detached negative prototype rows used by
           the contextual rotation reducer. Default 4 when omitted. -->
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextNegatives" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextSituationWeight" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextSituationAnchors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptualContextExpectationWeight" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- <definitionSparsityScale> (snap contract sec 5, 2026-07-06): lambda
           for the rank-ordered soft-L0 that keeps concept definitions compact
           (shrinks the surplus concept->symbol in-edges past definitionFreeSize).
           Default 0.0 = no penalty, byte-identical. -->
      <xs:element name="definitionSparsityScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="autoload" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="autosave" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="checkpointEveryBatches" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="profile" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="certainty" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Automatic sentence expectation; ARMA remains separately weighted.
           sentenceExpectation replaces the retired sentencePrediction name. -->
      <xs:element name="sentenceExpectation" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="sentenceExpectationScope" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="structured"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="root"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <xs:element name="armaScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationGain" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationPolicyWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="expectationQueryBudget" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- In-STM autoregressive prediction (IntraSentenceLayer). Loss
           weight on the per-word L_intra = MSE(predicted idea, observed
           idea), added to the IR-loss path. The PI-then-Sigma predictor
           is owned by ConceptualSpace. -->
      <xs:element name="intraLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Inter-sentence end-state prediction. Structured scope scores
           distinct occupied NP1/VP/NP2 vectors plus presence logits;
           root scope retains the historical single-vector MSE baseline.
           This scales the mean over eligible observed sentences. -->
      <xs:element name="interLossWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- InfoNCE next-idea contrastive term: weight + softmax temperature.
           Reuses the InterSentenceLayer end-state chain (positive next root
           ranked above the chain's past roots). 0.0 weight -> MSE-only
           (byte-identical). -->
      <xs:element name="interContrastiveWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="interContrastiveTemp" type="positiveFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="partSpaceType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="nInput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nActive" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Native part-event width (compact percept WHAT plus the canonical
           band). In aligned serialObjectMeta it may be narrower than CS, but
           its sparse sigma/codebook activation reads the conceptual-width
           code before CS; CS does not project these coordinates. -->
      <xs:element name="nDim" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nInputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nVectors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Logical ceiling for boundary-safe radix percept growth.  When

      <xs:element name="nWhere" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhen" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="passThrough" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- DEPRECATED QKV legacy alias; inert. See attentionModeEnum. -->
      <xs:element name="hasAttention" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Symbolic-retrieval mode (off|primer|second-order|low-rank);
           default off. Supersedes <hasAttention>. See attentionModeEnum
           and doc/plans/2026-06-06-symbolic-heat-retrieval.md. -->
      <xs:element name="attention" type="attentionModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="invertible" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nonlinear" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Stage 5 (doc/plans/2026-05-26-two-loop-pi-sigma-substrate.md):
           optional butterfly cascade on PartSpace.pi for
           cross-element FFT-style mixing over the flattened [B, N*D]
           view. When ``butterfly=true`` the PiLayer is built with the
           cascade enabled. The cascade length N is AUTO-COMPUTED from
           the space shape (nInput * nInputDim) and internally padded to
           the next power of two; there is no explicit length knob (the
           former ``<butterflyN>`` element was retired 2026-06-05; the
           cascade derives N from the shape). Default off; configs that
           don't opt in see the legacy PiLayer construction unchanged. -->
      <!-- DEPRECATED alias for <sigmaPi> (true -> butterfly, false/absent
           -> last). New configs should use architecture-level <sigmaPi> instead. -->
      <xs:element name="butterfly" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- PartSpace is subsymbolic: its <codebook> element was retired
           (2026-06-09, asymmetric-VQ plan §7 task 7). PS behaviour is fixed
           to "none" (continuous .event passthrough; percept prototypes live
           on the .what Embedding). Only WholeSpace carries a <codebook>. -->
      <!-- Concept-dictionary VQ / growing-capacity knobs. Logical prefix
           activation belongs only to ConceptualSpace; WholeSpace properties
           use an independent inventory and growth lifecycle. -->
      <xs:element name="commitmentDecay" type="positiveFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookRetire" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookEmaDeadThreshold" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookGrowthEpsilon" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- wordLearning (formerly chunkingFrequency): controls active
           lexicon growth. 0 = frozen codebook (training-time default);
           >=1 = on first sight of a new word, insert it into the
           lexicon and tag it as a part of the "words" symbol on the
           meronomy. Only embed.py sets >0 at lexicon-build time. -->
      <xs:element name="wordLearning" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Phase 4 of the analysis/synthesis dual-input plan (rev.
           2026-06-09): the perceptual front-end knob is SYNTHESIS,
           the bottom-up union of atoms into chunks/surface forms. It
           was named ``<chunking>``; the legacy spelling is REJECTED
           LOUDLY by the PartSpace reader (no silent aliasing).
           ``analyse`` is accepted here only until Phase 4b moves the
           meronymic analyzer to WholeSpace <analysis>. -->
      <xs:element name="synthesis" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <!-- ``meronomy`` is the sole canonical implementation (the
                 PartSpace fold ladder, doc/plans/2026-09-10-meronomy-fold-
                 ladder.md). Every other value is LEGACY: schema-valid for
                 older experiments and checkpoints, validated and dispatched
                 by bin/Legacy.py, never entering the canonical branch. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="bpe"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="mphf"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="lexicon"/>
            <!-- ``none``: byte-direct.  Each byte becomes its own
                 perceptual slot via a 256-entry codebook lookup; no
                 BPE walker, no Python trie, no graph break at the
                 chunking boundary.  ``\0`` (byte 0) doubles as the
                 sentence-end / pad sentinel.  Requires nVectors>=256
                 and dataType=embedding.  See doc/Spaces.md
                 §"Chunking modes" for the cognitive rationale.
                 ``byte`` is the canonical spelling; ``none`` is its
                 legacy alias. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="none"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="byte"/>
            <!-- Stage 7 (doc/plans/2026-05-27-perceptstore-meta-
                 taxonomy-reentrancy.md): ``radix`` routes chunking
                 through a ``PerceptStore`` (radix trie + hash map +
                 inverse table + learned codebook + byte fallback +
                 promotion). An alternative to Lexicon/MPHF/BPE for
                 the surface-form authoritative store; opt in with
                 ``<synthesis>radix</synthesis>``. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="radix"/>
            <!-- ``meronomy`` (doc/Mereology.md#mereological-algorithm): the canonical synthesizer.
                 Combines parts into a DOMINATING whole (join-from-bottom +
                 isotonic .where projection = the concept lattice, inert until
                 wired) AND isolates words (tags each percept by its WORD via
                 Meronomy.word_spans over the raw surface, so word_groups is one
                 agreed WORD grid for PS/WS/CS; the serial per-word commit +
                 autobind mint one word/object/meta per word). Paired with the
                 WholeSpace <analysis>meronomy</analysis>. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="meronomy"/>
            <!-- the PartSpace ``analyse`` synthesis was REMOVED (Phase 4b, rev.
                 2026-06-09): the meronymic analyzer is top-down ANALYSIS and
                 lives on WholeSpace as <analysis>grammatical. Configs that ran
                 PS analyse migrate to <synthesis>lexicon (the closest surviving
                 word-resolution mode). -->
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <!-- Stage 7: radix-mode promotion knobs. ``chunkPromotionThreshold``
           is the byte-fallback hit count at which an unknown chunk
           gets promoted into the trie + codebook (default 4).
           ``chunkPromotionMinLength`` is the minimum chunk length
           (in bytes) below which promotion never fires (default 2).
           Both are ignored when chunking != "radix". -->
      <xs:element name="chunkPromotionThreshold"
                  type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="chunkPromotionMinLength"
                  type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- The percept store's WORD collection (type="words",
           RadixLayer.word_ids: promoted word-bounded entries) becomes the
           reverse() recommenders' candidate basis (rows of PS .what,
           restricted via left_rows/right_rows). Default FALSE (absent =
           off, byte-identical basis pick). See
           doc/plans/2026-07-12-word-store-typed-reverse.md. -->
      <xs:element name="wordStore" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

      <xs:element name="codebookRetire" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>

           serialize through its structural checkpoint sidecar. WholeSpace is
           upstream and contains property vectors only. -->
      <xs:element name="taxonomy" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="wholeSpaceType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="nInput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nActive" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Native whole/property event width. Canonical aligned models keep it
           equal to PartSpace's native event width. A conceptual-width
           nInputDim is the recurrent input interface; it does not make WS a
           downstream PS stage and does not change WS's native output width. -->
      <xs:element name="nDim" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nInputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Initial WholeSpace property-vector inventory. It is independent of
           ConceptualSpace.nVectors and downstream symbol-reference capacity.
           Canonical text models may begin with a small ASCII property basis;
           future dynamic properties can grow it only at an explicit ownership
           reset boundary. -->
      <xs:element name="nVectors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhere" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhen" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- <initScale> (2026-07-06 fidelity leg, doc/plans/2026-07-06-concepts-
           formalization-and-snap-contract-*.md): per-row seed magnitude for
           this space's property codebook and freshly discovered properties.
           Small values (~0.02) keep the
           sigma/pi folds in their linear regime (tanh saturation grows with
           fold depth x row scale). Omitted / 0 = current behavior (unit /
           [-1,1] hypercube prefill), byte-identical. Direction-preserving: a
           uniform per-row scale leaves dot-product argmax selection
           unchanged. -->
      <xs:element name="initScale" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Phase 4b (analysis/synthesis dual-input plan, rev. 2026-06-09):
           WholeSpace owns the top-down ANALYSIS knobs.
           <lexer> (moved here from InputSpace): the intake granularity
           InputSpace executes - lexing is analytic cutting.
           <analysis>: the division strategy over the unity view.
             byte    = uniform contiguous regions (default; the stage-0
                       region-mean pooling).
             word    = whitespace-cut parts; per-part coarse means.
             analyse = the meronymic analyzer front end (space-lexer cut
                       today; the bottom-up merge integration follows with
                       the deeper SS analyzer work, Phases 5-6). -->
      <xs:element name="lexer" type="lexerEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- <analyzer> REPLACES <lexer> (doc/Mereology.md#mereological-algorithm): tokenization is
           analytic cutting, owned by the analysis side (the meet-from-top
           mereological analyzer). <lexer> is the deprecated spelling; the
           config reader accepts both, preferring <analyzer>. -->
      <xs:element name="analyzer" type="lexerEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Task 5 (C-13, asymmetric-vq sec.6): the post-sentence semantic
           arrangement weight over SS heat (pode attraction + antipode
           repulsion on the activated codebook rows). Default 0 = OFF:
           the mechanism is validated under D (corpus, serial path). -->
      <xs:element name="semanticArrangement" type="nonNegativeFloat"
                  minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="analysis" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <!-- <analysis> is the UNIFIED WholeSpace knob; it absorbs the lexer
                 options (raw/byte/word/sentence; <lexer>/<analyzer> are the
                 deprecated spellings) PLUS the analysis-only modes. The
                 lexer-valued options set the surface lexer; the analysis-only
                 values (grammatical/meronomy) leave the lexer at raw and select
                 the division. ``meronomy`` is the sole canonical division (the
                 WholeSpace descending ladder, doc/plans/2026-09-10-meronomy-
                 fold-ladder.md); every other value is LEGACY, dispatched by
                 bin/Legacy.py. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="byte"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="word"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="raw"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="sentence"/>
            <!-- ``grammatical`` (formerly ``analyse``): the property/boundary
                 analysis that cuts a whole into grammatical parts. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="grammatical"/>
            <!-- ``meronomy``: the meronymic word-isolation cut (1-x dual of the
                 meronomy synthesizer), paired with <synthesis>meronomy. -->
            <xs:enumeration value="meronomy"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <!-- T3 (doc/plans/2026-07-10-wholes-are-types-segmentation.md):
           within-whole division of unattested type-runs into attested
           concepts. A type-run whole whose surface is NOT itself an attested
           percept divides by greedy longest-match tiling into attested
           standalone concepts (complete tilings only; an attested whole
           always stays ONE concept). "Attested" = a multi-byte percept-store
           entry (promotion = standalone recurrence), or a single byte that
           has occurred as its own type-run; spell_out's seeded byte
           percepts alone do not attest. Default TRUE (live wiring); explicit
           false keeps the undivided span (the pre-T3 unattested fallback). -->
      <xs:element name="divideWithinWhole" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Every DIGIT byte is a whole by itself at the analysis cut, so a
           numeral word divides into its digits (each with its own .where).
           Default false (byte-identical). Alec 2026-09-10: the digit whole. -->
      <xs:element name="digitWholes" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Initialisation of the learned boundary predicates (fold-ladder
           plan, contract 3): canonical (the four classes as priors) or none
           (no boundary type; the cold-start test). -->
      <xs:element name="boundaryLearningRate" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="boundaryDensityWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="boundaryUpdateEvery" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="boundaryTypeWeight" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Present whitespace runs as units whose grammatical operation is
           the null operation (fold-ladder plan, contract 3), instead of
           discarding them as a boundary-only class. Default false. -->
      <xs:element name="whitespaceUnits" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="boundaryTypes" minOccurs="0">
        <xs:simpleType>
          <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="canonical"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="none"/>
          </xs:restriction>
        </xs:simpleType>
      </xs:element>
      <xs:element name="passThrough" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Symbolic-retrieval mode (off|primer|second-order|low-rank);
           default off. WholeSpace has no hasAttention legacy alias:
           it never constructed a QKV AttentionLayer. See attentionModeEnum
           and doc/plans/2026-06-06-symbolic-heat-retrieval.md. -->
      <xs:element name="attention" type="attentionModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="invertible" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nonlinear" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Optional butterfly cascade on the WholeSpace sigma operator
           (cross-slot mixing, needed for tasks like XOR that combine
           positions; the cascade length is auto-computed from the space
           shape; see partSpaceType/butterfly). -->
      <!-- DEPRECATED alias for <sigmaPi> (true -> butterfly, false/absent
           -> last). New configs should use architecture-level <sigmaPi> instead. -->
      <xs:element name="butterfly" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebook" type="codebookModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="sortNetwork" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="sortPasses" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="l1Lambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="discontinuityLambda" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="symbolResidualScale" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="outputSymbolResidualScale" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="commitmentBeta" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- VQ-VAE EMA decay (``VectorQuantize.decay``).  Higher = slower
           adaptation, more stable assignment across time; lower =
           faster drift but less stable.  Default 0.9 (see
           doc/Spaces.md §"Codebook drift sync"). -->
      <xs:element name="commitmentDecay" type="positiveFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Dead-code retire: when a slot's EMA ``cluster_size`` falls
           below ``codebookEmaDeadThreshold``, replace it with a fresh
           sample from the current input batch.  Off by default
           because reseeding can blow up the effective number of
           distinct codes on non-stationary data; enable for
           growing-codebook semantics where novel inputs should evict
           rarely-used slots. -->
      <xs:element name="codebookRetire" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebookEmaDeadThreshold" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Novelty insertion threshold for ε-growing codebook semantics.
           When > 0, ``VectorQuantize.grow_on_novelty`` inserts an input
           vector into an empty slot whenever its min-distance to the
           live codebook exceeds this value.  0 disables (use
           dead-code retire above, or fixed-size codebook). -->
      <xs:element name="codebookGrowthEpsilon" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="decorrelationWeight" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="spectralFlatnessWeight" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="impenetrableAntisymmetry" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="impenetrableTransitivity" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="impenetrableOverlap" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="impenetrableVariance" type="nonNegativeFloat" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="tetralemmaOverride" type="tetralemmaOverrideType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="TetralemmaPolicy" type="tetralemmaPolicyType" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="outputSpaceType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="nInput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutput" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nActive" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nDim" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nInputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nOutputDim" type="xs:integer" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nVectors" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhere" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhen" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="invertible" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="codebook" type="codebookModeEnum" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nonlinear" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- lrScale: multiplier on the base learning rate for the OutputSpace
           (readout) parameters only; they go in their own Adam group at
           lr*lrScale. Default 1.0 (single group, byte-identical). >1 lets the

      <xs:element name="lrScale" type="xs:decimal" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="conceptIds" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       SymbolSpace section — unified container for grammar infrastructure
       (SyntacticLayers, TruthLayer) and the per-batch inter-sentence
       ARMA(p, q) predictor (InterSentenceLayer). Sentence-level AR
       lives here, not in the within-sentence body — the body is now
       a pure IR (masked-LM) forward.

       InterSentenceLayer shape knobs live in this section
       (armaP / armaQ / armaHiddenDim); the loss weight lives under

  <xs:complexType name="symbolSpaceType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="syntacticHiddenDim" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="truthMaxEntries" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhere" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="nWhen" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- InterSentenceLayer ARMA(p, q) shape knobs. p = AR lag count
           (number of previous sentence reps); q = MA lag count
           (number of previous prediction errors); armaHiddenDim is
           the MLP predictor's hidden layer width.  Defaults: p=5,
           q=2, hiddenDim=2*sentence_dim (computed at construction

      <xs:element name="armaP" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="armaQ" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="armaHiddenDim" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Long-term-memory (LTM) chain capacity: the InterSentenceLayer
           bounds its per-row chain of STM end-states (the AR sequence

           Separate from <truthMaxEntries> (TruthLayer's SS-codebook
           capacity). Default 1024. -->
      <xs:element name="ltmCapacity" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <!-- Stage 3 cleanup (2026-05-27): parserBackend, routerKind,
           chartTau, chartTopK, chartNoiseEps retired alongside
           the chart. The signal router (LanguageLayer) is the
           canonical parser. The retired elements raise loud
           ValueError at config load time; see

      <!-- Soft-superposition output collapse mode; preserved for the

      <xs:element name="chartCollapse" type="chartCollapseEnum" minOccurs="0"/>

      <!-- Number of P->C iterations per word in the per-word stem path. -->
      <xs:element name="iterationsPerWord" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>

      <xs:element name="downwardGeneration" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="language" type="languageType" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="embeddingsType">
    <xs:all>
      <xs:element name="numShards" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="maxDocs" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="vectorSize" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="trainingEpochs" type="xs:positiveInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="minCount" type="xs:nonNegativeInteger" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="artifactPath" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:all>
  </xs:complexType>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       Language section (inside <SymbolSpace>)
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <!-- ``start`` may repeat: multiple ``<start>`` tags define accepted
       unreduced forms / start patterns (see test_grammar_start_rule), so

  <xs:complexType name="languageType">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="start" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
      <xs:element name="grammar" type="grammarType" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="interpretation" type="unitInterval" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="grammarType" mixed="true">
    <!-- Grammar XML is intentionally open: configs may carry inline

    <xs:sequence>
